brief: GS Prime's Equity Fundamental L/S performance estimate fell -1.48% between 10/30 and 11/5 (MSCI World TR fell -3.55%), as -2.07% beta losses were partly offset by +0.60% alpha from long-side gains. The Systematic L/S estimate fell -0.61%, driven by -1% alpha from short-side losses, offset by +0.39% beta. Overall book gross leverage rose slightly to 314.2% (85th percentile) while net leverage fell to 71.8% (4th percentile) and the L/S ratio fell to 1.592 (3rd percentile); Fundamental L/S gross and net leverage both fell further. Global equities were net sold (-1.0 SDs) as de-grossing accelerated to its largest dollar pace since July, long sales outpacing short covers 5-to-1, led in dollar terms by Europe and DM Asia. All regions except DM Asia were net sold, led by EM Asia and North America; DM Asia saw its largest net buying in 6 months. Single Stocks were net sold for an 8th straight week while Macro Products were net bought for a 3rd. 8 of 11 sectors were net sold, led by Info Tech, Industrials and Energy, while Real Estate, Utilities and Materials were net bought; Global Industrials saw its largest net selling in over 5 years.
